baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative joins خَلَقُوا to the total span السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ and closes with بَل لَا يُوقِنُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Origination is tested against the entire upper-cover/lower-ground field: speakers unable to settle the causal question are confronted with whether they themselves brought that field into being.

activation_trace.role: Bringing something into being supplies the literal authorship claim placed under interrogation.
What rises and covers supplies the upper boundary of the created totality.
Lower ground opposite the sky supplies the complementary lower boundary.
Settled knowledge after doubt is removed makes the closing negation an epistemic failure, not merely missing information.

changed_reading.before: A rhetorical denial that the addressees made the universe.
changed_reading.after: A causal-warrant test: those without a settled account of origin are made to face the impossible authorship of the whole upper-to-lower field.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: خَلَقُوا at word 2 stands before the vertically opposed السَّمَاوَاتِ and الأَرْضَ at words 3-4.
baseline_models.mechanism: Creation can be heard as prior measuring and proportioning. Height and lower ground then form calibrated poles, so the object of doubt is not generic existence but the measured coherence spanning them.

activation_trace.role: Measuring and proportioning before action turns creation into calibrated arrangement.
Elevation supplies one pole and the vertical extension of the measured field.
The lower counterpart to the sky closes the measured field at its opposite pole.
The refusal of settled knowledge blocks the inference from coordinated measure to an adequate cause.

changed_reading.before: Creation names an undifferentiated act producing two cosmic objects.
changed_reading.after: Creation also names the proportioning of a continuous vertical order; their uncertainty fails specifically at reading coordinated measure as causal evidence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The live branch range of خ ل ق at word 2 includes both origination and fabricated speech, while السَّمَاوَاتِ and لَا يُوقِنُونَ keep the activation cosmic and epistemic.
baseline_models.mechanism: Without replacing the verbal sense of خَلَقُوا, the fabrication branch lets the question carry a second pressure: have they authored the account by which they name and explain the cosmos despite lacking settled knowledge?

activation_trace.role: Fabricated or forged speech adds an exploratory verbal-authorship echo to physical creation.
Naming as indication makes the heavens not only an object but an item within an asserted explanatory vocabulary.
Negated settled knowledge exposes the gap between confidently authored account and warranted conclusion.

changed_reading.before: The question concerns only impossible physical manufacture.
changed_reading.after: Alongside that reading, it probes whether their cosmic account is self-fabricated speech presented without settled causal knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later question about another deity and its rejection of partnership resolves the focus authorship alternatives toward exclusive causal agency. Creating the whole upper/lower field cannot be partitioned among human claimants or divine partners.

activation_trace.role: Origination and bringing into being supplies the causal agency whose exclusivity is tested.
The upper covering supplies one half of the total domain over which causal agency is claimed.
Lower ground opposite the sky completes the indivisible causal field.
Settled knowledge is denied where the causal alternatives should have resolved.
The worshipped deity supplies the only category in the window capable of answering the total causal claim.
Otherness, exception and negation supplies the proposed alternative causal source.
Exoneration and declaring freedom from defect rejects the alternative as an improper attribution.
Participation and shared ownership supplies the causal partition explicitly denied.

structural_cues: 52:35-36 tests self-creation and cosmic creation; 52:43 later tests another deity and closes by rejecting partnership.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sequence of creator alternatives followed by other-deity and partnership language; I infer that 52:43 resolves the causal field opened at 52:35-36 toward exclusive agency. A live alternative is that 52:43 concerns worship alone rather than retrospective cosmology.

changed_reading.before: The question merely denies that the addressees personally made two cosmic regions.
changed_reading.after: It opens a causal elimination that later excludes both another deity and shared agency: the whole upper/lower field points to undivided authorship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby creator claims are tested by a sharp agent-patient reversal: those intending a scheme become its objects, and their scheme later provides neither efficacy nor support. Bounded agents whose action rebounds cannot plausibly occupy the unbounded creator role posed in the focus.

activation_trace.role: Origination supplies the maximal active role against which the later reversal of lesser agency is measured.
Settled causal knowledge is what their exaggerated self-placement lacks.
Plotting and contrivance supplies both the intended action and the action turned back upon its planners.
Forceful handling supplies the effort that nevertheless fails to benefit its agents.
Aid that makes one prevail supplies the support explicitly unavailable when their agency collapses.

structural_cues: 52:42 repeats ك ي د across intended action and passive exposure; 52:46 repeats the scheme but denies both benefit and aid.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit agent-to-patient reversal and later failed efficacy; I infer that this bounded agency answers the nearby creator pretension by abduction. The alternative is a moral reversal unrelated to the cosmological question.

changed_reading.before: The addressees are simply denied the historical act of cosmic creation.
changed_reading.after: Their very mode of agency disqualifies the creator claim: they scheme as actors but become acted upon, unsupported and unable to secure even a lesser result.

context_deltas.mechanism: Charges of invented speech and a demand to produce comparable discourse immediately turn into doubled creation questions. Verbal authorship rebounds as ontological authorship: those assigning a human source to revelation must account for the source of themselves and the cosmic field.

activation_trace.role: The fabrication branch preserves a verbal-authorship resonance inside the focus creation verb.
Actual origination keeps the rebound anchored in the ontological force of the focus question.
Negated settlement diagnoses their confident attribution as unwarranted rather than neutral speculation.
Saying what did not occur or falsely attributing it supplies the explicit verbal-fabrication charge.
Renewed speech or report supplies the artifact they are challenged to produce.
Truthful speech makes production answerable to a truth condition, not merely rhetorical skill.
The doubled origination terms pivot from producing discourse to accounting for producers themselves.

structural_cues: 52:29-35 moves through labels, reported accusations, a production challenge and then two خ ل ق forms immediately before the focus repeats the root.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, repeated authorship vocabulary and the creation/fabrication branch range; I infer a deliberate reciprocal transfer from alleged speech authorship to creaturely and cosmic authorship. The live alternative is a series of independent challenges linked only by rhetoric.

changed_reading.before: 52:36 adds another isolated question about who made the heavens and earth.
changed_reading.after: It completes an authorship reversal: people quick to explain revelation as human production cannot explain the producers, much less the created totality.

context_deltas.mechanism: The questions following the focus enumerate increasingly demanding credentials: control, a route upward, acquired hearing, compelling proof, possession of the hidden and an authoritative record. Lack of certainty becomes lack of any licensed access path supporting their cosmic claims.

activation_trace.role: The overhead realm supplies the destination whose alleged knowledge requires access.
Settled knowledge supplies the epistemic state for which the following questions demand credentials.
Supervisory domination supplies the first claimed credential: control over what is discussed.
A ladder as steps and means supplies a physical route to the upper domain.
Auditory reception supplies the proposed information channel reached by that route.
Compelling proof supplies the public warrant required from the alleged listener.
What is hidden from sight supplies the inaccessible domain they would need to possess.
A written determination with binding force supplies the strongest claimed record of hidden knowledge.

structural_cues: After 52:36, the interrogatives rotate through control, ascent and hearing, manifest proof, possession of the unseen and writing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the credential sequence; I infer that it retrospectively specifies what would be needed to justify a settled cosmic claim. The alternative is that each question targets a separate claim without forming a graded warrant test.

changed_reading.before: لَا يُوقِنُونَ describes a private shortage of confidence.
changed_reading.after: It denies an evidential license: they have neither control, access channel, compelling proof nor hidden record from which a cosmic conclusion could settle.

context_deltas.mechanism: Actual sight of a descending sky-fragment is followed by its verbal recoding as piled cloud. The obstacle to certainty is therefore not simply absent evidence; perception can be admitted while its causal significance is renamed away.

activation_trace.role: The focus upper covering is the same visible domain from which the later fragment comes.
Settled knowledge is the endpoint that perception and interpretation fail to reach.
Vision by eye and insight explicitly grants perception before the interpretive response.
A detached piece of a body or sky supplies the disruptive object actually seen.
Falling downward supplies the event's unmistakable directional change.
Speech as belief or doctrine turns naming into the interpretive frame imposed on sight.
A cloud drawn along supplies the normalizing label substituted for the disruptive fragment.
Layering one thing above another makes that substituted cloud-label materially plausible enough to deflect inference.

structural_cues: 52:44 grammatically grants seeing the descending fragment before reporting the observers' cloud-label.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies perception, a descending object and immediate relabeling; I infer defensive recoding that blocks settlement. A materially live alternative is sincere misidentification rather than motivated resistance.

changed_reading.before: They are uncertain because decisive cosmic evidence has not reached them.
changed_reading.after: Their uncertainty can survive decisive sight by recategorizing the sign, so لَا يُوقِنُونَ marks interpretive immunity as well as evidential lack.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later negation of knowledge places the focus negation of certainty on an epistemic gradient: disclosure or recognition may be absent, but even what is recognized may fail to become settled, doubt-removing knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Fixed knowledge after doubt is removed supplies the stronger state denied at the focus.
Disclosure of a thing to a knower supplies the later, broader cognition also negated.
A distinguishing trace that guides to its object supplies the sign-to-knowledge route that remains ineffective.

structural_cues: 52:36 has بَل لَا يُوقِنُونَ; 52:47 returns to a negated cognition with وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two different cognition roots in parallel negations; I infer a distinction between disclosed recognition and settled certainty. The alternative is rhetorical variation without a ranked epistemic relation.

changed_reading.before: The close says only that they do not know for sure.
changed_reading.after: It isolates a failure of settlement: signs may disclose or distinguish, yet they do not become doubt-removing causal knowledge.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant س م و to و س م mapping, not the ordinary sky branch. It remains valid as a focus-root activation tied to word 3 and to negated certainty; downstream prose should present it as a sign-reading analogy, never as a lexical gloss of السَّمَاوَاتِ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: السَّمَاوَاتِ at word 3 is mapped in the packet to visible-mark branches as well as the dominant elevation root, and لَا يُوقِنُونَ at word 7 names the failed epistemic result.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark makes the heavens function experimentally as an evidence-bearing surface.
Inferring condition from a mark supplies the exact observation-to-conclusion operation that can fail.
Settled knowledge supplies the absent conclusion despite the marked field.

changed_reading.before: The heavens are only one immense object whose production is questioned.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they are also a marked evidence-field: visible traces invite causal inference, yet the observers do not let those traces settle into certainty.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the third-ranked س م و to س م م mapping and its narrow-opening image. It remains anchored to the focus heavens and is independently activated by the later ladder, hearing and proof sequence; render it only as a spatial model of epistemic access, not as the meaning of السماء.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: السَّمَاوَاتِ at word 3 supplies the bounded upper domain, and لَا يُوقِنُونَ at word 7 supplies the failed knowledge claim that the access model explains.

activation_trace.role: A narrow aperture through which something enters recasts the upper domain as a boundary with restricted access.
Settled knowledge is the claimed result for which an access route would be required.
A ladder as means supplies the attempted route to the imagined aperture.
Hearing supplies the information sought beyond the boundary.
Compelling proof supplies the absent warrant that any report from that route must carry.

changed_reading.before: Their uncertainty is an undefined inward hesitation about cosmic creation.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is an access failure: they claim about the upper domain without aperture, route, reception or compelling warrant.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the remote nominal branch of ي ق ن concerning protected seclusion, not the verbal sense of يُوقِنُونَ. It remains anchored to focus word 7 and gains structural support from hiddenness and protective watching later in the window; prose must present it only as an affective-spatial analogy for settled cognition.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: لَا يُوقِنُونَ at word 7 directly supplies the cognition root, while the overhead covering at word 3 gives the exploratory image an enclosing spatial frame.

activation_trace.role: A protected secluded interior supplies the branch-distant image of cognition kept from disturbance.
Doubt-removed settled knowledge keeps the analogy tied to the ordinary epistemic force.
What rises and covers supplies an enclosing spatial counterpart without changing the meaning of heavens.
Concealment from eyes supplies the inaccessible exterior against which protected inner settlement is imagined.
An eye of preservation and care supplies protective oversight rather than self-made closure.
Restraining the self from panic supplies the practice that preserves inner settlement under pressure.

changed_reading.before: Certainty is only a high numerical degree of confidence about creation.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, certainty is a protected inner settlement under care; their lack of it leaves causal judgment exposed to every relabeling and pressure.

strongest_changes: The focus shifted from generic origination to a causal test spanning a measured upper/lower totality.
The speech-production challenge made cosmic creation a reciprocal authorship test rather than an isolated rhetorical question.
The other-deity and partnership question sharpened the focus toward exclusive rather than divided causal agency.
The reversal of plotter into plotted exposed the addressees' bounded agency as incompatible with creator pretension.
The later sight-and-relabeling sequence made lack of certainty an interpretive resistance that can survive direct evidence.
summary.what_was_special: The trace kept several mechanisms alive at once: causal authorship, measured vertical order, verbal fabrication, exclusive agency, bounded counter-agency, evidential licensing, resistant relabeling and strange sign/aperture/protected-interior activations. Non-dominant and form-distant branches changed readings without being promoted into lexical claims.
remaining_uncertainties: The transfer from fabricated discourse to ontological authorship is abductively strong but not grammatically compulsory.
The other-deity question may retrospectively resolve causal agency or may address worship without modifying 52:36.
The reversal of plotting may diagnose creaturely agency or may remain a separate moral reversal.
The contrast between ي ق ن and ع ل م may mark an epistemic gradient or only rhetorical variation.
The marked-heavens and aperture readings depend on packet-supplied non-dominant root mappings and must remain explicitly exploratory.
